findings.highlight: And if during that time, I heal more, that's even better.
findings.evidenceJa: その間にこっちの体も完治してくれれば御の字だし。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks it would be ideal if his body completely recovered during lunch.
findings.explanation: Complete recovery during lunch becomes merely healing more.

findings.highlight: "Shirou? That's easier. Shirou, huh... Yep, it has a nice ring to it. It's simple, but also kind of haughty at the same time."
findings.evidenceJa: 「シロウ？　なんだ、思ってたよりカンタンな名前なんだね。そうか、シロウか。……うん、響きは合格ね。単純だけど、孤高な感じがするわ」
findings.governingReading: Illya says Shirou’s name sounds simple but solitary, aloof, or nobly self-contained.
findings.explanation: A name that sounds solitary and elevated becomes haughty.

findings.highlight: I find myself shifting my weight so I can be ready to run at an instant, purely by instinct.
findings.evidenceJa: 思わず体が反応して、いつでも動けるように腰を落とした。
findings.governingReading: Shirou lowers his stance so he can move at any instant in response to Illya.
findings.explanation: Readiness to move becomes readiness specifically to run.

findings.highlight: If she gets it in her head, she can probably just order him to crush me, along with the florist next to me.
findings.evidenceJa: その気になれば、お隣の花屋さんもろとも俺を吹っ飛ばせるだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks that if Illya chose, she could blow him away together with the neighboring florist.
findings.explanation: Illya’s potential force becomes an order to Berserker to crush Shirou.

findings.highlight: The little girl tugs on my arm, as if she were taking her father's hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は、それこそ父親の手をとるような自然さで俺の腕に抱きついてきた。
findings.governingReading: Illya embraces and clings to Shirou’s arm with the natural ease of taking her father’s hand.
findings.explanation: Illya clinging to Shirou’s arm becomes a tug.

findings.highlight: She smiles wide as she says this.
findings.evidenceJa: 笑顔で、さりげなくとんでもないコト言ってるし！
findings.governingReading: The narrator exclaims that she is smiling while casually saying something outrageous.
findings.explanation: The narration’s shock at Illya’s casual cruelty disappears.

findings.highlight: The next thing I know, I'm reaching for Illyasviel—argh, her name is too long—Illya's waist, and try to catch her before she falls to the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 気が付けば、俺は咄嗟にイリヤスフィール—ああもうめんどくさい、イリヤの腰に手を伸ばして、倒れかけた彼女の体を支えていた—
findings.governingReading: Shirou reflexively reaches for Illya’s waist and supports her before she falls.
findings.explanation: A malformed coordination interrupts Shirou catching Illya.

findings.highlight: It's also why, even though she left me behind, I don't even consider taking the opportunity to run for it.
findings.evidenceJa: こうして一人になった俺が、今がチャンスとばかりに逃げだす可能性を考えない。
findings.governingReading: Illya runs ahead without considering that Shirou, left alone, might use the chance to escape because she believes his promise absolutely.
findings.explanation: Illya’s failure to imagine Shirou fleeing becomes Shirou’s refusal to consider flight.

findings.highlight: She sure is unstable.
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもないアンバランスさだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls the coexistence of Illya’s menace and pure trust an extraordinary imbalance.
findings.explanation: Illya’s profound imbalance becomes instability.

findings.highlight: I haven't yet gotten to an age where I'm so cynical as to betray a little girl's trust.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな真っ白な信頼を裏切れるほど、俺も大人になれている訳じゃなかった。
findings.governingReading: Shirou wryly says he has not become adult enough to betray such pure-white trust.
findings.explanation: Shirou not being adult enough to betray pure trust becomes not yet being cynical with age.

findings.highlight: "I don't really find anything in particular boring, but...okay, what do you think is fun?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「いや、つまんないって言われてもな。……ならイリヤは何が面白いっていうんだよ」
findings.governingReading: Shirou objects that being told the topic is boring gives him nothing to work with, then asks what Illya finds interesting.
findings.explanation: Shirou answering “even if you say it’s boring” becomes a claim that he finds nothing boring.

findings.highlight: "I see. It's a lot colder than usual today. You'll just have to endure the cold for now, but...where did you come from? Your name sounds kind of noble or something."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうか。いつもはそうでもないんだけど、今日は妙に寒いからな。寒いのが苦手なら堪えるだろうけど……その、イリヤはどっから来たんだ？　なんか、随分と貴族っぽい名前だけど」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that today is unusually cold and that if she dislikes cold it must be hard on her.
findings.explanation: Sympathy for Illya’s difficulty with cold becomes a dismissive command to endure it.

findings.highlight: "Huh? Well, I'm an apprentice mage without a Magic Crest, but I'm a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 「？　いや、魔術刻印のない半人前の魔術師だけど、マスターだぞ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls himself a half-fledged magus without a Magic Crest, while affirming that he is a Master.
findings.explanation: A half-trained, incomplete magus becomes an apprentice.

findings.highlight: I was never taught magecraft."
findings.evidenceJa: 普通の魔術なんて教わらなかったもの」
findings.governingReading: Illya distinguishes herself from an ordinary magus by saying she was never taught ordinary magecraft.
findings.explanation: Not being taught ordinary magecraft becomes never being taught magecraft at all.

findings.highlight: I take out the dorayaki, a Japanese pancake sandwich filled with red bean paste, I'd bought to give Saber, and without knowing why, I hand it to Illya.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと食べる筈だったどら焼きを袋から出して、これまたなんとなく、イリヤへと差し出した。
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes out dorayaki he had intended to eat with Saber and offers it to Illya.
findings.explanation: A snack Shirou planned to share with Saber becomes one bought to give her, replacing planned companionship with a gift.

findings.highlight: "Want it? It's not the fanciest thing, but it's good."
findings.evidenceJa: 「食べるか。安物だけど」
findings.governingReading: Shirou offers the sweet while apologetically calling it inexpensive.
findings.explanation: Calling the dorayaki cheap becomes praising it as good but unfancy.

findings.highlight: She practically devours the thing.
findings.evidenceJa: その仕草は、ほおばるという表現がぴったり来るほど元気いっぱいだった。
findings.governingReading: Illya eats with such energetic delight that “stuffing her cheeks/mouth” is the apt expression.
findings.explanation: Illya stuffing her cheeks becomes practically devouring the sweet.

findings.highlight: I nibble my dorayaki and try to hold stop myself from being overwhelmed by the shocking thought I've just had.
findings.evidenceJa: もぐり、とこっちもどら焼きを食べて、後頭部を襲ったショックに耐える。
findings.governingReading: Shirou tries to withstand the emotional shock of imagining Illya as a little sister.
findings.explanation: A duplicated verb leaves Shirou’s sentence malformed.

findings.highlight: Honestly, I can't even begin to imagine how a mage family raises a child.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の家系に生まれた子供がどんな風に育てられるか、俺はおぼろげにしか想像できない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou can imagine only vaguely how a child born into a magus family might be raised.
findings.explanation: A vague, limited ability to imagine magus upbringing becomes no ability at all.

findings.highlight: But I know without a doubt that Illya wasn't raised in a normal environment.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも—イリヤの生まれた環境が普通でないのは感じ取れる。
findings.governingReading: Despite knowing little, Shirou can sense that Illya’s upbringing was not ordinary.
findings.explanation: Shirou sensing an abnormal upbringing becomes certainty beyond doubt.
